sanskrit:
आवृतं ज्ञानमेतेन ज्ञानिनो नित्यवैरिणा ।
कामरूपेण कौन्तेय दुष्पूरेणानलेन च ॥ ३-३९॥
iast:
āvṛtaṃ jñānametena jñānino nityavairiṇā
kāmarūpeṇa kaunteya duṣpūreṇānalena ca 3-39
translation: Enveloped, O Son of Kunti, is wisdom by this constant enemy of the wise in the form of desire,  which is difficult to be appeased, like fire.
